page.title: RKSV operating mode
page.subtitle: Controls the DEMO label on receipts (RKSV.Mode). Separate from development mode (TSE health bypass).
page.warning: Changes apply immediately to new receipts and daily closings. Existing receipts are not rewritten.
page.fiscalWarning: These settings affect ALL fiscal receipts on this instance. Super Admin only.
page.saveSuccess: RKSV operating mode saved. New receipts will use the new labelling.
page.saveConfirmContent: Changes apply to ALL new fiscal receipts (POS and Admin). Already printed receipts do not change. Continue?
page.lockBlocked: Production lock blocks Demo/Simulation on this host.
page.showDemoLabel: Show DEMO / NICHT FISKAL on receipts
page.showDemoLabelHint: Independent of the TSE device. Controls visible labelling only.
page.bypassTseInDevelopment: Bypass TSE health checks in Development
page.bypassTseInDevelopmentHint: Default off so TSE can sign locally. Ignored when TSE mode is Real, and never applies on Production hosts.
page.tseBypassBlockedByReal: TSE health bypass is disabled because RKSV TSE mode is Real. Probes and signing run.
page.tseBypassEffective: TSE health checks are currently bypassed on this Development host.
page.devModeNote: “Bypass TSE checks” in development mode does not change receipt text. Control receipt DEMO and Development TSE bypass here. TseMode=Real always runs real TSE probes.
page.hardwareNote: Hardware TSE (Tse:TseMode / Provider) stays in appsettings. This dialog does not change the signature chain.
